repos_data.description: 🪽 An open, easy, fast, reliable and battery-efficient solution for real-time communications
Small self-contained pure-Go web server with Lua, Teal, Markdown, HTTP/2, QUIC, Redis, TypeScript, npm-less React 19, SQLite, and PostgreSQL support ++

🦎 A lightweight, streaming-native, multi-protocol gateway for AI, APIs, and real-time data. Route LLM requests across providers, govern MCP tools, and connect Kafka, MQTT, and HTTP through one high-performance engine with shared security and observability.
Production-grade Server-Sent Events (SSE) for Fiber v3. Event coalescing, priority lanes, topic wildcards, adaptive throttling, built-in auth, Prometheus metrics, graceful drain.
